CustomField.description: How much the Stepper buttons and the Slider move per step on a numeric field. It never restricts typed values: a step of 1 still accepts 10.50, because validation keeps using the field's own decimal places. Leave blank to step by the field's smallest decimal increment.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How much the Stepper buttons and Slider move per step. Typed values are never restricted to multiples of this amount. Leave blank to step by the field's smallest decimal increment.
CustomField.label: step
